verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no automation or workflow objects in Weaviate, and nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. Backup and restore covers data and collections, not automations, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit. A vector database could plausibly ship triggers or agent workflows with version history, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
